title: Perfect MuseScore Ver.

source.reason: MuseScore-style MIDI has a clear melody track and a sparse left-hand accompaniment track.

conversion_notes: Generated from the uploaded MuseScore-style MIDI file.
Track 0 is used as the main melody; track 1 is used as lower-register accompaniment.
Source contains F# pitch classes, so the arrangement is transposed +5 semitones to fit the natural-note G3-C6 angklung rack.
Melody is intentionally kept in the lower/middle upper physical range G4-C6 instead of being forced into the extreme top octave.
Accompaniment is folded into the lower physical register G3-F4.
This is a draft simulator/test arrangement. It is not demo_safe until reviewed on the real angklung rack.

warnings: Max simultaneous notes at same beat: 3.
This arrangement is for simulator/display testing first; motor safety still needs review.

arrangement_policy.melody_target_range: G4-C6; do not force melody into C6-only/top octave
arrangement_policy.melody_octave_policy: lowered/middle-upper pitch policy for a more natural angklung sound
arrangement_policy.accompaniment_octave_policy: fold support chords downward into the physical lower register

tracks.description: Main melody mapped to G3-C6 rack, kept lower than the previous high-octave Perfect draft.
Sparse supporting lower-register accompaniment from the second MIDI track.
